item.title: Apex Files Honey Badger Wars Part 4. A Jackal Pack's Deadly Mistake
item.description:
They stopped attacking the den directly. So they tried something else instead.
After three failed direct confrontations, the predators circling Scar's burrow in Part 4 of Honey Badger Wars shift strategy — from open attacks to a slower, harder-to-counter siege. This episode picks up straight from the Part 3 cliffhangers: the rival lion coalition's roar, and the unresolved wild dog den.
🦡 Previous episodes: Part 1 — Honey Badger vs African Rock Python Part 2 — Honey Badger vs Baboon Troop vs Leopard Part 3 — Honey Badger vs. Hyena Clan
